    • balance

      @NotNull @NotNull BigDecimal balance(@NotNull @NotNull QUser user, @NotNull @NotNull String world, @Nullable @Nullable String currency)

    • deposit

      boolean deposit(@NotNull @NotNull QUser user, @NotNull @NotNull String world, @Nullable @Nullable String currency, @NotNull @NotNull BigDecimal amount)
      Deposits the specified amount of currency into the user's account in the specified world.
      Parameters:
      user - the user whose account will receive the deposit
      world - the world in which the user's account exists
      currency - the currency to be deposited (can be null if default currency is used)
      amount - the amount to be deposited into the user's account
      Returns:
      true if the deposit was successful, false otherwise

    • transfer

      default boolean transfer(@NotNull @NotNull QUser from, @NotNull @NotNull QUser to, @NotNull @NotNull String world, @Nullable @Nullable String currency, @NotNull @NotNull BigDecimal amount)
      Transfers the specified amount of currency from one user to another user in the given world.
      Parameters:
      from - the user from whose account the amount will be transferred
      to - the user to whose account the amount will be transferred
      world - the world in which the users' accounts exist
      currency - the currency in which the amount will be transferred (can be null if default currency is used)
      amount - the amount to be transferred from one user to another
      Returns:
      true if the transfer was successful, false otherwise

    • withdraw

      boolean withdraw(@NotNull @NotNull QUser user, @NotNull @NotNull String world, @Nullable @Nullable String currency, @NotNull @NotNull BigDecimal amount)
      Withdraws the specified amount of currency from the user's account in the given world.
      Parameters:
      user - the user from whose account the amount will be withdrawn
      world - the world in which the user's account exists
      currency - the currency in which the amount will be withdrawn (can be null if default currency is used)
      amount - the amount to be withdrawn from the user's account
      Returns:
      true if the withdrawal was successful, false otherwise
